card.name: Casting and metalwork context words
card.fires_on: Small words and spaces right where a metal-related noun is expected next, such as after 'cast' or 'produced for' a bell foundry, or after a metal property label. Also fires on numbers inside foundry history dates.

modes.label: Bell and foundry casting
modes.description: Linking words after 'cast' or 'produced' in text about bells and foundries, just before a maker or foundry name.
modes.example: was cast<< at>> the Whitechapel Foundry in London

modes.label: Metal property tables
modes.description: The space after a property label in a list of element data, before a number.

modes.label: Coin and sculpture works
modes.description: Words before a maker or coin name in text about coins or cast artworks.
modes.example: the work<< of>> Lycius, which had been dedicated

card.writes: It pushes toward metal and metallurgy words such as metal, ceramic and smelting, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on small filler words in text about casting metal, bells and element data, where a metal term is likely next.
